total_model.summary: Model projects 46.8 total points (ARI 23, WAS 24). Biggest factors: Combined pass defense EPA allowed/play (raises total 1.8), Combined offense EPA/play (last 8 games) (lowers total 1.6), Combined defense EPA allowed/play (recent-weighted) (lowers total 1.1). The baseline of 45.7 is the typical NFL total in the training data.
